title: twas-xcal: ancestry-aware null calibration for transcriptome-wide association studies
description: Maintenance development source. Reported scientific analyses remain v0.3.0, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.24062489. Current source adds retained-coverage, allele-frequency metadata, validation and resumption fixes. No new scientific results are claimed. The t reference and diagonal uncertainty propagation are approximate; estimated-parameter extreme-tail calculations reuse pilot SEs and omit a–c covariance. See docs/SUBMISSION_REVIEW.md for current qualifications.
